method.filtering_summary: Live search at 7:30 AM EAT on 13 sources (12 answered; ReliefWeb failed) pulled 1,996 postings. 1,441 were older than 7 days or old reposts, 250 senior or excluded titles, 163 not target roles, 42 excluded Kenya, 1 already applied and 45 duplicates. Of the 54 that passed, 29 hadn't been shown before. A close read of each posting removed nearly all of them: GoFasti hires only in Latin America, VirtusLab only in Poland, Affirm only in Spain or Poland, KDCI's form was Philippines-only, and ADG's new Forward-Deployed Engineer post asks for 10+ years. micro1's own jobs portal was checked directly: three new micro1 roles open worldwide lead the list even though they are stretches, and a fourth (AI Product Evaluator) is limited to India, Japan or the UK. Canonical's Secure Container Images role also fit but was already shown before, so it isn't repeated. Nothing old was carried over.

stories.title: xAI launches the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for Grok
stories.summary: More than 130 companies joined the early-access phase, and Transformation Partners are training engineers through a Forward Deployed Engineer accreditation program at more than 30 organizations.
stories.why: Forward-deployed Grok work is becoming its own job category, which fits the FDE roles he targets.

stories.title: Grok Bot v0.75.2 adds editable Pages and video creation
stories.summary: Bots can now build Pages such as reports, memos and dashboards that users edit together or have the Bot keep up to date, plus create videos from a description or image.
stories.why: Agent products are moving from chat answers to standing, auto-updated work, the kind of automation he builds.

stories.title: OpenAI nears up to $30B raise at a $1.25T valuation before an IPO
stories.summary: Investors from the UAE and Coatue are leading the round at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, positioned as a bridge ahead of a potential IPO.
stories.why: Record AI funding keeps money flowing to the AI tooling and integration jobs he applies for.

stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B ahead of a China IPO
stories.summary: The Chinese AI lab raised about $15 billion (about 100 billion yuan), two days after the US ordered federal civilian agencies to remove its technology, Bloomberg reported.
stories.why: Open-model labs are scaling fast, which keeps open-weight models cheap for the automation work he does.

stories.title: Former OpenAI science lead's Warp Sciences raises $215M
stories.summary: Kevin Weil's lab-automation startup raised $215 million at an $865 million valuation in a round led by Lightspeed.
stories.why: Another well-funded AI startup that will need engineers who connect models to real-world workflows.

stories.title: Flutterwave lets employees borrow against their shares
stories.summary: Through US lender Techdollar, staff can borrow against vested shares for 6 to 12 months, typically under half their value, at 0.80% to 1.5% a month.
stories.why: Useful context on how equity pays out at African fintechs if he weighs a startup offer.

stories.title: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs and eBay 1,000
stories.summary: Barclays says the cuts, mostly developer and support roles, follow AI investment, and it plans £150 million for retraining by 2030; eBay is cutting about 9% of staff.
stories.why: Big-company developer and support roles are shrinking, so AI-automation skills matter more.

stories.title: AI labs' own job boards show 3,826 open roles
stories.summary: A tracker of 20 AI employers counted 3,826 open roles on 21 October, including 302 at xAI and 808 at OpenAI, with 175 entry-level US titles.
stories.why: Hiring at AI companies is still strong, though most roles are US-based.

stories.title: Safaricom launches Fuliza Ya Pochi overdraft for small merchants
stories.summary: The overdraft targets more than one million Pochi La Biashara merchants who have used Pochi for over six months, with repayment taken from future wallet payments.
stories.why: M-PESA keeps adding credit products, which drives demand for fintech engineers in Nairobi.

stories.title: Safaricom explains how Fuliza limits are set
stories.summary: Safaricom said NCBA Bank sets Fuliza limits from repayment history, airtime use, M-PESA activity and repayment patterns, and limits can be refreshed once a month via *334#.
stories.why: A plain look at the credit-scoring inputs behind Kenya's biggest overdraft product, close to his Kwara loan work.
